body.name: Certified finite-to-limit evaluation handle
body.construction: On input \(n\), use exactly \(M_n=\lfloor n^{1/72}\rfloor\vee1\), \(T_n=2^{\lfloor(\log_2n)/12\rfloor}\), \(\varepsilon_n=T_n^{-1}\), \(G_n=\lceil n^{3/4}\rceil\), and \(\delta_n=n^{-3/2}\). Represent \(\alpha_n\) by \(nX^3-1\), its unique positive root, and a rational isolating interval. Enumerate the eight response types; the lexicographic \(m\), \(x^{\mathrm{obs}}\), and \(H\) indices; every \(\mathcal S_{n,j}(M_n)\) and \(\mathcal Z_{n,A}\); and the rational action mesh of resolution \(G_n\). Evaluate all four tube cells and every posterior-risk term exactly in \(\mathbb Q(\alpha_n)\), compare algebraic values by isolating-interval refinement, and retain the rational certificate \(U_{n,G_n}^\dagger\). Return rational enclosures \(B^-_{n,\varepsilon_n,T_n,\delta_n}\le B_{n,\varepsilon_n,T_n}^\dagger\le B^+_{n,\varepsilon_n,T_n,\delta_n}\) of width at most \(\delta_n\), together with canonical width-\(2^{-n}\) outward shell maxima. For \(\ell=n\bmod8\), build \(\mathcal U_{n,\ell}\) and \(\mathcal I_{n,\ell}\), enumerate the fixed compact chart atlas, compute the three finite coefficient arrays and quotient recurrence with the finite-lattice coefficient extractor, and certify the fixed-coordinate Euler--Maclaurin and uniform Stirling remainder sums. Refine the isolating intervals until \(n^{4/3}(B^+-B^-)\) meets its assigned rational tolerance. On input \(\eta\), test the explicit single-schedule error bound and its certified tail inequalities in increasing \(n\), and return the first threshold \(N^\dagger(\eta)\) whose proved tail bound is at most \(\eta\).
